-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → IMSCRIB → CLINK → AFWD → EVALT → EVALF → ENGAGR → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: ob3ect
notes:
Auto-designed from: <domain-context>

<catalog-entries>
[entry: The_Entity] The Entity
  tuple: grounding= is_grounded= metadata= Ç=𐑧 Ð=𐑦 Þ=

phase_0.boundary_condition: The bracketed catalog entry [entry: The_Entity] encloses the empty tuple and the symbol to Shavian glyph map, sealing the object definition.
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: The mapping of Latin symbols to Shavian characters such as Ç to 𐑧
AFWD.justification: Each assignment directs a source mark toward a rendered counterpart, a forward morphism from signifier to glyph.

AREV.chosen_element: The inverse recovery of a symbol from its Shavian glyph
AREV.justification: A contravariant path descends from written form back to the catalog symbol, though unwritten it is implicit in the map.

CLINK.chosen_element: The sequential chaining of the three tuple fields into one record
CLINK.justification: grounding, is_grounded, and metadata compose a single attribute block through ordered concatenation.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: The coexistence of undefined tuple and resolved glyph map
ENGAGR.justification: The Entity holds both the empty attributes and the full symbol set simultaneously without reconciliation.

EVALF.justification: The unset attribute evaluates as false, signalling the Entity is not yet instantiated.

EVALT.justification: The self mapping evaluates as true, confirming the symbol equals itself.

FFUSE.chosen_element: The absent reconstitution of a split
FFUSE.justification: With no split performed, no multiplication reunites branches; the Entity remains whole.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: The absent fork in the Entity's unitary description
FSPLIT.justification: The domain presents no branch; the tuple stays a single object and no co multiplication occurs.

IFIX.chosen_element: The permanent catalog inscription of the entry
IFIX.justification: Once written, the entry is append only and cannot be undone, fixing the Entity in record.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: The self equality ⊙=⊙ within the symbol list
IMSCRIB.justification: The identity symbol maps to itself, marking the Entity's reflexive self reference without transformation.

TANCH.chosen_element: The closing bracket of the catalog entry
TANCH.justification: The entry block terminates the description and contains the Entity's entire declared surface.

VINIT.chosen_element: The Entity's ungrounded tuple with empty grounding, is_grounded, and metadata slots
VINIT.justification: The catalog line shows these fields unset, placing the Entity in a pre instantiation void before any attribute is named.

phase_2.failure_reason: The domain description is a flat catalog entry with no branching operation; no FSPLIT/FFUSE pair is instantiated, therefore FFUSE(FSPLIT(x)) = x cannot be demonstrated.

phase_3.both_description: The Entity simultaneously carrying undefined tuple fields and a defined set of glyph mappings.
phase_3.false_description: The empty grounding= slot indicating absence of instantiation.
phase_3.true_description: The identity relation ⊙=⊙ holding as a self equal sign.
phase_3.void_description: The Entity before the catalog entry exists, with no tuple fields or symbol mappings.

steps.domain_action: The Entity appears as an ungrounded tuple with empty grounding, is_grounded, and metadata fields
The catalog marks ⊙=⊙, fixing the Entity's self identity within the record
The three tuple slots chain into a single composite attribute block
Each Latin symbol Ç Ð Þ Ħ Ř ƒ ɢ Γ Σ Φ Ω is mapped forward to its Shavian glyph
The identity mapping ⊙=⊙ is evaluated as true, confirming self equality
The empty grounding= field is evaluated as false, showing the Entity is not yet instantiated
The Entity holds both the undefined tuple and the resolved symbol set without reconciliation
The catalog entry is permanently inscribed as an append only record
The [entry: The_Entity] bracket closes, anchoring the system boundary

phase_5.alfs_store: The root catalog document containing all entity entries
phase_5.compiler_frontend: The catalog parser that reads the tuple line and the symbol mapping line
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The textual layout of the entry linking fields and glyph assignments
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The catalog file that stores the entry as persistent text
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The linear reading order of the entry from header to symbol list

phase_6.cycle_cost: A single write of the entry consumes file space and parser time
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0, the inscription is a deterministic record keeping act with no disorder change
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The entry persists with tuple and glyph map inscribed
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: No entry for The Entity exists in the catalog
